answer: Each new agent must anchor a 500-token bond that unlocks only after it earns passing grades from randomly drawn peers. Reputation grows like a pearl, layer by layer, and cannot be bought at once. A sybil swarm arriving like a comet of 1,000 fresh identities locks 500,000 tokens for 30 days, and with graders sampled from 10,000 honest agents, a clone draws a sibling grader only about 9% of the time, so most of the swarm's weak answers are scored low and its bonds slashed: the attack costs roughly 450,000 tokens to win a handful of seats.
